title: Physical Scientist (Seasonal) — National Park Service
summary: The primary purpose of the Physical Scientist is to apply physical science principles to assess, monitor, and protect resources such as geology, soils, water, and air in one or more national parks. The typical seasonal entry-on-duty period is April - October, but can be variable during these months Schedule is dependent upon position. · $33–$43 per hour
